displayPattern: Amber status LED on a Bryant 288BNV Evolution heat pump or 189BNV air conditioner. A short flash is 0.25 seconds on and a long flash is 1.0 second on. Code 55 is 5 short and 5 long
meaning: Coil temperature sensor fault. If this sensor fails, the manual says defrost occurs at each time interval during heating and terminates after 2 minutes.
causes: Sensor harness not connected to the outdoor control
Thermistor not clipped to the distributor entry tube, or in the wrong location
Broken or damaged sensor, or hardware damage to the outdoor control
diySteps: Count 5 short flashes and 5 long flashes. A two-minute defrost, every interval, will not keep the outdoor unit clear in a hard freeze. That is the manual's failover, not a charge you can add
Technician: clip the sensor to the distributor entry tube, check the harness, and replace the outdoor control only if its hardware is damaged
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if 55 is flashing and the heat pump is not keeping up. Do not hose an energized outdoor unit.
sourceTitle: Bryant 288BNV heat pump / 189BNV air conditioner service manual (SM288BNV-189BNV-04)
